description: Create a co-parenting monthly expense reconciliation spreadsheet. Sheet 1 'Custody Days': Track March 2024 custody calendar (You: days 1-4,8-11,15-18,22-25,29-31; Ex: days 5-7,12-14,19-21,26-28; Split: day 16 counted as 0.5 each). Calculate total days and percentages. Sheet 2 'Expenses': Enter 8 expenses with categories (Medical/Educational/Extracurricular/Disputed/Routine), amounts, and 50% split calculations. Sheet 3 'Summary': Create formulas for total expenses, extraordinary expenses (50/50 items), and reimbursement amount owed. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).

metadata.real_world_context: Co-parenting expense reconciliation required by divorced/separated parents with custody agreements
